notes: PDA1 rates cross-checked against the company source file TAK26063 KASSIOPI.GR.xls and against the GPHA Port Tariff Aug 2023 (digitized) on 2026-07-11. Pilotage/Towage/Mooring/Shifting/Anchorage/Light Dues/ISPS/PIDD matched the GPHA tariff exactly and are unchanged. 'Harbour Rent' was a flat-rate approximation of GPHA's real Berth Occupancy Charge (LOA-banded, first-24h + per-12h-block formula) -- removed from this table and now computed directly in pda_engine/rate_engine.py (see harbour_rent_line()). 'Port Dues on Vessels' (1A1001, Schedule 1.A) was tried and removed again on 2026-07-12: its own tariff remark restricts it to 'vessels that did not load/discharge cargo or passengers during their call' -- every call this platform prices is a cargo-working call (currently: Takoradi clinker discharge, Free Out), so 1A1001 never applies within the platform's current scope and is intentionally excluded from this rate library rather than carried as an inactive/placeholder row. It's still fully present in tariff_reference (code 1A1001) if a future module ever needs to price a non-cargo-working call (bunkering-only, crew change, etc.). PDA2 lines with a GPHA equivalent are now populated from the tariff; the rest remain placeholders because they are not GPHA charges (GSA levy, admin/release, draft survey, taxes) or need a driver not yet collected (labour delay hours). 2026-07-18: Ammonium Nitrate (bagged, via MAXAM Ghana) added -- required a platform-wide correction along the way: Pilotage/Tug Assistance/Mooring/Shifting (2A2xxx-2A5xxx) were flat rates matching only the 30,000-40,000 GT band (every reference vessel used so far happened to be in that band); GPHA's real Second Schedule GT-bands them 11 ways, now modeled with the same grt_min/grt_max mechanism as the Environmental Charge. Also added: extra 50% tug charge for any vessel GT < 10,000 (GPHA General Terms B(6), any cargo); ISPS/PIDD Conventional Cargo class rates; GSA Levy Bagged rate; a new per_unit_with_minimum basis for Craneage (GPHA 3H6001, min ,200 vs .34/t, only when a crane is deployed -- gearless vessels only); and a new liner_routing mechanism (rate_engine._select_liner_routed_rows) so Port Dues on Cargo/Stevedoring/Labour Delays/Stevedoring O'time/Cranage move between the Principal and Receiver PDA depending on liner terms (Free Out / Liner Out-LILO / Full Liner Terms), while GSA Levy and Admin/Release Fee always stay on the Receiver.
